verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an account-onboarding flow could expose application status, but no evidence shows a founder viewing status while the application is under review. The Applications API is a partner-side pre-fill flow: Ramp emails the applicant, who finishes sign-up in the UI. Its applications:read scope describes only submitting and managing financing applications, with no documented status visibility. The incorporation company-status endpoint tracks LLC formation, not a Ramp account application, so it is a different capability and earns no credit here.
